steps.title: A burst becomes one call
steps.titleZh: 一连串调用只执行一次
steps.text: Every call cancels the timer of the previous one and starts a new one, so the function runs only once, 500 ms after the last call. This button calls it five times in a row.
steps.textZh: 每次调用都会取消上一次的定时器并重新计时，所以函数只在最后一次调用 500 ms 之后运行一次。这个按钮会连续调用它五次。
steps.actionLabelZh: 连续调用 onClick() 五次

steps.title: Cancel a waiting call
steps.titleZh: 取消一次等待中的调用
steps.text: `debounced.cancel()` drops a call that is still waiting, so `1 2` never prints.
steps.textZh: `debounced.cancel()` 会丢掉仍在等待的调用，所以 `1 2` 永远不会打印。

steps.title: Try the real button
steps.text: Click **Test Debounce** on the page several times quickly: nothing prints while you keep clicking, then `1 2` appears once.
steps.textZh: 快速连点页面上的 **Test Debounce** 几次：一直点的时候什么也不打印，停下来之后 `1 2` 出现一次。
